subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement for this UI resolver fix?
rationale: The source-level issue remains, but an open fork PR already carries the focused resolver/test change and blocks a new automated repair lane.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale fork/check state.

options.title: Replace with a same-repo PR
options.body: Leave the fork aside and author a fresh same-repository UI-only resolver fix with Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale fork/check state.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the channel UI/catalog path and recent channel UI refactors among the likely owners.
